result.reason: The redline does not reach the playbook position. It omits the required prohibition on assignment by Garman to a Sparkling competitor. More importantly, retained clause (c) still requires Garman’s written authorization for Sparkling to assign the Agreement, directly conflicting with the new affiliate and successor carve-out in clause (d). The added prohibition on re-pricing is not required by the stated position and expands the change beyond what is necessary. Although the consent reasonableness standard and no-termination protection are appropriate, the internal inconsistency and additional re-pricing restriction impair intent preservation and drafting quality.
